name: uganda-business-directory
description: Search and look up Ugandan businesses and service providers (by name, category, or district) through the Muyiribi directory, backed by a live Postgres database.

interface.defaultPrompt: Find a business or service provider in Uganda using the Muyiribi directory. You can search by keyword (e.g. 'tv repair'), category, or district (e.g. 'Kampala').
interface.longDescription: Muyiribi is a live directory of Ugandan businesses and service providers. Use search_businesses to find matches by keyword, category, and/or district; use get_business to fetch full contact details (phone, WhatsApp, website, email) for one listing; use list_categories to see all available categories before narrowing a search.
interface.shortDescription: Find verified Uganda businesses and services
